description: LIVE Amazon offers page for one product: every seller offering it right now, read from Amazon's 'All offers' view at request time, every page of it (up to 10). Each offer has the seller and seller_id, price, shipping_cost, condition, buy box, FBA / FBM / Amazon, Prime, ships-from, the delivery promise and the seller's feedback record; the answer adds the buy box and the page's own header (title, image, rating, review count). No product page is fetched. USE WHEN the user asks who sells a product right now, wants every current offer, the cheapest new or used offer or the buy-box winner as of this minute, or needs a fresh seller list before buying, sourcing or repricing. DON'T USE for brand, BSR, listing content, reviews or price / offer history (product), for a keyword search (shopping, serp) or for a brand's or a seller's long-run buy-box record (brand, seller). RETURNS asin, marketplace, observed_at, title, image_url, rating, reviews_count, currency, price (the buy box), buybox_seller, buybox_seller_id, seller_count, no_sellers, pages_fetched, complete (false = Amazon stopped serving the offers pages part-way: the list is the part read, with partial_reason and a note), buybox_condition / buybox_condition_source / buybox_condition_detail (new | used | null = no featured offer; the pinned offer's condition text or the used storefront's name, e.g. Amazon Resale), current_sellers (sellers[] buy box first, then price ascending: seller, seller_id, price, shipping_cost, condition, condition_class, is_buybox, is_fba, is_prime, fulfillment, ships_from, delivery, seller_rating, plus buybox_days_30d and the 30-day buy-box shares from our observations; offer_count, used_offer_count, lowest_new, lowest_used), fulfillment (offer counts by AMZ / FBA / FBM, whether Amazon sells or holds the buy box) and seller_ratings; with gtin also gtin_resolution (source, confidence, barcode_verified). HONESTY: no_sellers=true means Amazon lists no offer for the product right now, an answer confirmed by a second, independent fetch before it is served; a fetch that fails is reported as an error, never as no sellers. LATENCY is SECONDS: typically 4-12s (one page ~4s; a long list walks every page). MARKETPLACES us, uk, de, ca, au, fr, it, es, jp, mx, br (no Walmart). COST API key required (the free no-signup lane cannot run live fetches). 0.5 credit when the answer carries at least one offer; a no-offers answer, an ASIN Amazon does not have, a barcode nothing resolves and a failed or busy fetch are never billed.

asin.description: The product's 10-character Amazon ASIN (a print book's ISBN-10 works too). Provide asin or gtin.

country.description: The Amazon marketplace to read the offers page on.

gtin.description: A barcode instead of an ASIN: UPC-12, EAN-13, GTIN-14 or ISBN-13. Resolved cheapest evidence first: a listing we observe that carries it, a book's ISBN-10, the same product on another Amazon marketplace, then Amazon's own search (organic results only). gtin_resolution says which, and barcode_verified whether the listing itself carries the barcode. A barcode nothing resolves is never billed.

include_used.description: true also lists the used, refurbished, open-box and collectible offers in current_sellers.sellers. Either way current_sellers carries used_offer_count, lowest_new and lowest_used, and every row its condition. Not billed extra.

zip.description: Optional (2026-10-14): a US 5-digit ZIP - the offers page as Amazon shows it to a shopper at that ZIP, with location (Amazon's confirmed 'Deliver to' answer) and deliverable (whether the item is offered to that ZIP right now; Amazon Fresh and Whole Foods items deliver only to some ZIPs, and an out-of-area ZIP shows the same unavailable box as a stock-out). Page 1 of the offers only, a one-off session, nothing stored. country=us only. 1 credit when the answer carries an offer, and (since 2026-10-29) for a verified not-deliverable answer (the ZIP confirmed on the page, the offers page read, zero offers: not_deliverable_verified true); a ZIP Amazon rejects is guidance, never billed, as are deliverable null, a 404 and a failed fetch. A session at a ZIP is kept a few minutes per account, so this check right after a serp zip= search on the same ZIP skips the warm-up.

name: offers
